verdict.line: You lose if Kled lands the first Bear Trap hook while mounted and chains into Jousting and Violent Tendencies; you win if you drain Skaarl's bar from Cannon range and collapse the instant he dismounts.

brief.thesis: Kled's threat is gated by Skaarl's own health bar: while mounted he can all-in off a single Bear Trap hook, but once that bar empties he dismounts and deals reduced damage to champions until he rebuilds courage. Jayce's structural answer is to live in Cannon stance, draining that bar with ranged poke from outside his 550-range Jousting dash and 800-range Bear Trap hook, then punishing the window right after he dismounts.

theirWindow.what: His Q hooks from 800 range and yanks you in if held, then E (Jousting) dashes for extra damage while W (Violent Tendencies) gives him four empowered attacks. Don't feed minion aggro or walk into hook range on his cooldown windows.

yourWindow.what: Dismounted, his Q becomes the self-knockback Pocket Pistol and he deals less damage to champions. Step into Cannon autos or pop W (Hyper Charge) attack speed to burst him before he fights his way back to full courage and remounts.

start.why: Sustain and early trade damage to out-poke Kled's melee engages while you kite in Cannon stance, by far the most-picked start at 90.9%.

boots.why: Blunts the physical damage spike from W (Violent Tendencies)'s four empowered attacks and his auto-reliant all-ins.

core.why: Scales into Muramana's burst for your Cannon poke and keeps your mana pool from capping out trades early.
Active haste lets you close to finish a drained Skaarl bar or disengage from his Jousting dash.
Converts your mana into burst damage on Shock Blast and autos, the core of the poke-to-kill threshold.
Empowered auto after Shock Blast adds the extra burst needed for picks once Skaarl's bar is gone.

situational.when: he stacks health or tenacity and starts tanking your poke
you need the shield and burst to finish an all-in right after he dismounts
the game goes long and you need siege/split-push pressure

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the poke-then-reposition pattern: sustained Cannon damage pays out as burst movement speed to disengage before his Jousting dash or Bear Trap yank connects.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is both the highest-pick (54.7%) and highest-winrate (40.6%) combo here. Flash dodges the Bear Trap hook or a committed Jousting dash, and Teleport resets you to lane after trading so his Charge-driven split push doesn't go unanswered.

playing.title: Poke from Cannon range
playing.detail: Live in Cannon stance and auto/Shock Blast him from outside his 550-range Jousting dash and 800-range Bear Trap hook. Force him to overextend to trade back.

playing.title: Track Skaarl's bar, not his
playing.detail: Kled's mount has its own separate health pool. Once it's drained he dismounts and deals reduced damage to champions — time your all-in for right after it breaks.

playing.title: Respect mounted Bear Trap
playing.detail: While mounted with Q up, he can hook you from 800 range and yank you to him if he holds it. Don't eat minion aggro or stand still on his cooldown windows.

playing.title: Drop the gate before trading
playing.detail: Cast E (Acceleration Gate) and walk through before you engage, then fire Q (Shock Blast) through it for extended range, speed, and damage while the move speed also helps you kite his E (Jousting) dash.

playing.title: Punish spent Jousting
playing.detail: His E can be recast to dash back through the same target, but once both charges are used he has no other gap closer and is stuck at melee range with no escape.

playing.title: Collapse right after dismount
playing.detail: Dismounted, his Q is just a self-knockback Pocket Pistol instead of a hook. Step in with Cannon autos or W (Hyper Charge) attack speed before he rebuilds courage and remounts.

playing.title: Consider Cut Down
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read on this matchup specifically flags Cut Down as a damage tool against Kled's inflated effective HP from Skaarl — factor it in if your rune page has room.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are measured from real games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning, timing windows, and trade patterns are this brief's own tactical read, not measured data.
